scope: Only run_native_phase original-stage failure, raw receipt retention, terminal qualification and shared final-save boundary. Root owns native source/input/schema contract review.
checked: The original Consumer.stage writes its selected test/result evidence and raises on failure; run_native_phase preserves that first exception.
Observed native receipt bytes are retained through read_private before JSON qualification, including malformed actual emitted bytes. No decoding is required to retain failed observations.
Missing or later unreadable outputs cannot turn a failed stage into PASS, and later retention exceptions are secondary to the original XCTest failure.
Semantic qualification runs only when no earlier failure exists; observed status is explicitly non-acceptance and cannot stand in for a successful original XCTest/accepted receipt.

Shared save_result now also preserves the original exception when final directory creation or receipt writing fails; it appends/chains the later error and otherwise fails directly when no earlier failure exists.
Both native phase and enclosing four-stage consumer call the same final-save helper; failure is raised rather than returned as a successful result.
findingClosed: Initial 30c71df9 native adapter allowed final stage.mkdir/c.write to mask the earlier XCTest failure. Current shared save_result corrects that specific boundary.
boundary: This review does not qualify the native schema, Apple producer, runtime adapter admission, XCTest results, UI semantics, or physical-device acceptance.
